verdict.rationale: Otter documents a Public API, API & Webhooks on its pricing page, and an MCP server. These let external systems and AI tools read meeting data (transcripts, action items, search) and trigger actions based on meeting content. The evidence frames this mainly as data export and read access, not as programmatic control of the whole product. missing for 10: any documentation of UI parity via API (scheduling the notetaker, uploading/importing files, editing notes, managing channels or summaries, admin settings), a published API reference showing endpoint coverage, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
